description: This file contains the implementation of the jQuery One Page Nav Plugin, which provides smooth scrolling and navigation highlighting for single-page websites.

classes.name: OnePageNav
classes.description: Constructor function for the OnePageNav plugin, managing navigation behavior and scroll interactions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up event handlers, and calculates section positions.

methods.name: adjustNav
methods.description: Updates the navigation to highlight the current section.

methods.name: bindInterval
methods.description: Sets up a periodic check for scroll and resize events to update navigation state.

methods.name: getHash
methods.description: Extracts the hash part from a link's href attribute.

methods.name: getPositions
methods.description: Calculates and stores the top positions of each section linked in the navigation.

methods.name: getSection
methods.description: Determines which section is currently in view based on scroll position.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles click events on navigation links to perform smooth scrolling.

methods.name: scrollChange
methods.description: Updates navigation highlighting based on current scroll position.

methods.name: scrollTo
methods.description: Animates scrolling to a target section.
